I am 72 years old and I have farmed these lands since I was a boy. Beans do not need fertilizer like maize does—they fix their own nitrogen from the air—so I will save any inputs I have for my maize plots. I will plant local bean seeds saved from last season, work the plot with my family, and hire a young man for a couple of days to help with the heavy digging at planting time.
